name: Full Rotation 540°
source:
Synopsis:

I-the protagonist—held a young man named Takeda captive, breaking his spirit over the course of six months until he became submissive. However, Takeda subsequently developed a mental instability and began to bind me to him with extreme possessiveness. I found myself at my wits end as he resorted to threatening his own life to force my compliance. Although I took him to a hospital for treatment, Takeda ultimately fell from a balcony to his death, and I was sent to prison. This game explores "what-if" scenarios based on that premise, seeking paths where Takeda might survive.
Yet, most of these paths lead only to hell. It is a work that delves into human sadism, the desire for control, and the nature of love.

(Translated from itch.io page)
translation:
简介：

我——主角——俘虏了一个名叫武田的年轻人，在六个月的时间里折磨着他的精神，直到他变得顺从。然而，武田随后出现了精神不稳定，并开始以极端的占有欲将我与他捆绑在一起。当他用自己的生命来威胁我时，我发现自己束手无策。虽然我把他送往医院治疗，武田最终还是从阳台坠落身亡，而我也被送进了监狱。该游戏基于该前提探索“假设”场景，寻找武田可能生存的路径。
然而，这些道路大多数都只会通向地狱。这是一部深入探讨人类施虐狂、控制欲和爱的本质的作品。

（翻译自itch.io页面）
